Name: Festival Time Setter
Author: slpOff
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Festival Time Setter (v1.2.0)
[/size]
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]A small quality-of-life mod that makes festival days smoother in Stardew Valley.

[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod adjusts your in-game time after festivals and gives you more flexibility when entering buildings.

[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Features

[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Open doors on festival days[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Normally, many shops and houses are locked during festivals.
With this mod (configurable via GMCM), you can choose to still open doors if you need to enter.[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Custom festival time settings[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]You can configure both the [b]festival start time and end time[/b] through GMCM.
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]This allows players to customize when festivals begin and when they are considered finished.[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Sync time to the configured festival ending[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]When you attend a festival and return to your farm afterward, the in-game time will be set based on the [b]configured festival end time[/b].
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]This means the time you return home will automatically match the end time you selected in the mod settings.[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Festival attendance check[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]The mod only changes time if you actually joined the festival during its active hours.[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]If you skip the festival → no time adjustment.
If you enter after the festival has already ended → no time adjustment.[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Safe and clean behavior[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]If a festival doesn’t define an end time in the game files, the mod won’t run (no errors, no surprises).
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]Event handlers are cleaned up after use, ensuring no leftover effects on the next day.

[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Configuration (via GMCM)

[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Open Doors In Festival Day[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Default: [/font][code][font=Comic Sans MS]false[/font]
[/code][font=Comic Sans MS]Allows you to enter locked doors even on festival days.[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Festival Start Time[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Allows you to set when the festival begins.[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Festival End Time[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Determines when the festival is considered finished and also controls the [b]time you return home after attending the festival.

[/b][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Summary

[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod makes festivals less frustrating by:[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]letting you choose whether doors stay open,[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]allowing you to configure festival start and end times,[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]ensuring your in-game time matches the configured festival schedule,[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]only if you actually attended the festival.[/font]
